selection.summary: Issue #1241: first input position (0) invalid for a match on first usage of the context. Fix starts the reference at 1. Relevant delivered evidence: h0 (ZSTD_loadDictionaryContent in lib/compress/zstd_compress.c, where context is first used and match state initialized), h7 (zstd_fast.c dictStartIndex/first valid input position), h4 (zstd_double_fast.c dictStartIndex/match validity boundaries), h8 (zstd_compress_internal.h window/base pointer arithmetic where position 0 is problematic). Claims are provisional.

selection_posture: Exact terminal packet and response over independently receipt-bound branch evidence; explicit selected handles only.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.
